L49: # CLEP Military Benefits
L50: 
L51: To help military service members as well as eligible spouses and civil service employees reach their education goals, the U.S. government fully funds CLEP exams and administration fees so you can save money toward your degree.
L52: 
L53: These benefits are available to:
L54:   * Military personnel (active duty, reserve, National Guard): Army, Navy, Marine Corps, U.S. Coast Guard, Army Reserve, Air Force Reserve, Marine Corps Reserve, Navy Reserve, Coast Guard Reserve, Army, and Air National Guard.
L55:   * Spouses of: Coast Guard (active and reserve) and SpouseWorks eligible m ilitary spouses (formerly MyCAA).
L56:   * Civilian employees of: Air Force (must test at on-base or U.S. fully funded test centers).
L57:   * Veterans: If you're a veteran, you may be eligible to receive education benefits under the Forever G.I. Bill.
L58: ## Save Money Toward Your Education
L59: 
L60: CLEP exams are funded through the Defense Activity for Non-Traditional Education Support (DANTES) so you can focus on maximizing education benefits or making education benefits go further. Savings include:
L61:   * Free examination guide: 【29†DANTES-funded candidates who register for a CLEP exam】 receive a free CLEP exam guide based on your chosen exam topic. (The exam guides contain the same content and sample questions that appear in the CLEP Study Guide Apps).
L62:   * Funded exam fees: Eligible first-time test takers will have their exam fee funded by DANTES.
L63:   * Administration fees waived: DANTES-funded test centers and all on-base military test centers will also waive the administration fee for DANTES-funded test takers.
L64: ## Veteran Education Benefits
L65: 
L66: The Harry W. Colmery Veterans Educational Assistance Act, also known as the "Forever G.I. Bill," expanded education benefits to veterans, service members, families, and survivors. Veterans can use 【30†G.I. Bill funds†www.va.gov】 to cover CLEP exams and administration fees.
L67: ## FAQ

L71: 【1†How do I indicate that I'm eligible for a DANTES-funded CLEP exam?】
L72: 
L73: When purchasing an exam in the 【28†My CLEP†myclep.collegeboard.org】 student portal, you'll be asked if you're eligible for DANTES funding in the "Personal Information" section of the ordering process. Select "Yes." You'll then need to answer questions about your military status in order to receive DANTES funding.
L74:

L77: 【1†What do I need to bring on test day?】
L78: Bring your Geneva Convention Identification Card ID on test day. Refer to the 【32†DANTES Eligibility Chart (.pdf/473 KB)】 for additional information on IDs for active duty members, spouses, and civil service civilian employees.
L79: 
L80: 【33†Read more】

L82: 【1†How do I request my military transcript?】
L83: 
L84: To get a transcript for DANTES-funded CLEP exams, order it online by using the Parchment Transcript Ordering Service. A military transcript includes all scores for DANTES-funded CLEP exams taken after July 1, 1974.
L85: If you also took self-funded exams, you can order the transcript for those exams by logging in to the 【28†My CLEP†myclep.collegeboard.org】 student portal. Go to the "Scores" tab and click the Send Scores button to start the transcript ordering process.
L86:

L89: 【1†What is the military retest policy?】
L90: If you want to retake an exam previously funded by DANTES, you must wait three months and self-pay the exam fee and any administrative fees required by the test center. DANTES will only provide funding once for each CLEP exam subject.

L50: FAQ
L51: # If I am an active military service member, do I have to pay the exam fee to take a CLEP exam?
L52: 
L53: DANTES (Defense Activity for Non-Traditional Education Support) pays your exam fee and remote proctoring fee for the first exam attempt per test title. During registration, identify yourself as a DANTES candidate, and upon checkout, the exam fee and remote proctoring fee will be displayed to $0.00.
L54: 
L55: Please remember to bring your military ID on the day of testing.
L56: If you do not know whether your exam fee is funded by DANTES, contact DANTES at 850-377-4160 regarding your eligibility or check the DANTES Eligibility Chart.
